📉 What moved today, Wednesday 18 November: a tough day for Mzansi markets.

🇿🇦 The JSE Top 40 fell 3.9% to 98,733, its fourth losing day in a row. Resource shares dropped 6%.

🪙 Gold fell 2.3% to about $3,760 an ounce, below $3,800, after US central bank officials argued for more interest rate hikes.

💱 The rand broke through R17, ending at about R17.23 to the dollar, down 1.9%. Analysts quoted by Bloomberg pointed mainly to the gold drop.

🛒 At home, inflation rose to 5.2% in October.

What it means for you: a rand above R17 makes fuel and imports dearer, and it raises the stakes for tomorrow's Reserve Bank decision.

Prices are 15-minute delayed. Education, not financial advice.
